ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a schematic diagram of the butterfly life cycle, with cyclic arrows in the center. At the top is an adult butterfly, with B marked on the right; on the leaf on the right there is a group of small eggs, with C marked nearby; at the bottom is a caterpillar/larva, with A marked nearby; at the lower left is D, next to which is drawn a closed, sac-like structure hanging under a branch. Reasoning: The question asks what stage D depicts. The butterfly life cycle includes egg, larva/caterpillar, pupa/chrysalis, and adult. The hanging sac-like stage at D in the figure corresponds to the pupa, that is, chrysalis.
